summary.goal: Display real-time specialist observations in a minimal, scannable format. Specialists are dynamic (not fixed 5) and observations are freeform. Panel adapts to whatever specialists the Interviewer has spawned. Shows both per-specialist and session-wide confidence aggregation.

design_spec.layout: Vertical stack of specialist cards in right sidebar, with session confidence header

session_confidence_header.location: Top of panel, above specialist cards
session_confidence_header.display: Overall session confidence bar (0-100) + breakdown by specialist
session_confidence_header.aggregation_method: Weighted average across specialists and their domain categories

card_structure.header: Icon (by role_hint) + Specialist name + Confidence percent + Category count
card_structure.collapsed_summary: Key insights extracted from nested categories (max 3 bullet points)
card_structure.body_expanded: Full category details with per-category confidence

confidence_indicators.note: Specialists write 'confidence_level' as string (e.g., '75%') or per-category 'confidence' values
confidence_indicators.extraction_strategy: Parse confidence_level string or average per-category confidence values
confidence_indicators.per_specialist: Show as percentage badge + small bar
confidence_indicators.session_aggregate: Weighted average of all specialist confidences, displayed as full-width bar

nested_data_extraction.categories: Each top-level key (except reserved) is a domain category
nested_data_extraction.key_insights: Extract category names as summary tags
nested_data_extraction.concerns: Look for categories with low confidence (<50%) as implicit concerns

icon_mapping.note: Use role_hint to select icon, fallback to generic brain icon

acceptance_criteria.description: Panel shows cards for all active_specialists (dynamic count)
Specialist name displayed (from understanding keys)
Per-specialist confidence: parse 'confidence_level' string (e.g., '75%') or average per-category confidences
Session-wide confidence: aggregate bar shown in panel header, weighted average of all specialist confidences
Collapsed card shows: category names as tags (max 5), specialist confidence %
Expanded card shows: full category breakdown with per-category confidence values
Recommendations array extracted and shown as actionable items
Low-confidence categories (<50%) visually flagged as concerns
Panel updates in real-time as specialists contribute
Empty state when no specialists spawned yet
Panel is collapsible on smaller screens

decisions.rationale: Specialists write confidence as '75%' string - need to parse for aggregation
More informative than 'X categories' - shows what domains specialist is analyzing
Categories with <50% confidence are implicit concerns needing attention
Users need at-a-glance session readiness indicator

acceptance_criteria.description: ConfidenceDots({ level }) renders 3 dots
exploring: all dots empty/muted (text-accent-purple/30)
forming: 2 dots filled (text-warning)
confident: all 3 dots filled (text-success)
Each dot is 6px circle with appropriate fill

steps.title: Create specialist icon mapping
steps.description: Icon selection based on role_hint or specialist name

acceptance_criteria.description: getSpecialistIcon(name, roleHint?) returns appropriate icon component
Known hints map: 'architecture'->building, 'data'->grid, 'design'->palette, 'test'->flask, 'security'->shield
Name matching: 'Architect'->building, 'Designer'->palette, etc. (case-insensitive contains)
Fallback: generic brain/lightbulb icon for unknown specialists
All icons: currentColor, size prop (default 16px)
KeywordTag({ keyword }) renders pill-shaped tag
Styling: bg-accent-cyan/10 text-accent-cyan text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full
Truncates if keyword > 15 chars
AlertCount({ type, count }) renders icon + count
type='concern': warning icon, text-warning
type='question': help-circle icon, text-accent-purple
Hidden when count=0

steps.title: Create SpecialistCard component
steps.description: Card showing single specialist's freeform observations

acceptance_criteria.description: SpecialistCard({ name, roleHint, observations }) renders card
Header: icon (from mapping) + name + ConfidenceDots (from observations.confidence)
Body: KeywordTags from observations.keywords if present (max 5)
Footer: AlertCount from observations.concerns and observations.questions if present
Empty state if observations is empty object: 'Thinking...'
Card styling: bg-bg-card border-border-subtle rounded-lg p-3
SpecialistsPanel({ understanding, activeSpecialists }) renders panel
Header: 'Specialists' title with count badge
Body: SpecialistCard for each key in understanding (dynamic count)
Footer: total concerns/questions badge (aggregated from all)
Empty state when no specialists: 'Specialists will appear as needed'

steps.title: Create useUnderstanding hook
steps.description: Hook to get freeform understanding from session with real-time updates

acceptance_criteria.description: useUnderstanding(sessionId) returns { understanding, activeSpecialists }
Integrates with useSessionEvents for real-time updates
Returns Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> for understanding
Returns ActiveSpecialist[] for specialist metadata

steps.title: Integrate panel into IdeationLayout
steps.description: Wire up SpecialistsPanel as right sidebar

acceptance_criteria.description: SpecialistsPanel rendered in IdeationLayout right slot
Receives understanding from useUnderstanding hook
Only shown when viewing a session (not on empty state)
Respects collapse state from layout

steps.title: Create confidence extraction utilities
steps.description: Utility functions to extract and aggregate confidence from nested specialist data

acceptance_criteria.description: parseConfidenceValue(value) parses '75%' -> 75, 'confident' -> 80, etc.
extractSpecialistConfidence(observations) returns { overall: number, byCategory: Record<string, number> }
Checks for 'confidence_level' at root, falls back to averaging per-category 'confidence' values
Categories without explicit confidence default to 50%
Returns 0 if no confidence data found (still exploring)

steps.title: Create category extraction utilities
steps.description: Extract meaningful category summaries from nested specialist data

acceptance_criteria.description: extractCategoryNames(observations) returns string[] of domain category keys (excluding reserved keys)
extractCategoryDetails(observations) returns Array<{ name, confidence, itemCount, hasRecommendations }>
extractRecommendations(observations) finds and flattens any 'recommendations' arrays
identifyLowConfidenceCategories(observations) returns categories with confidence < 50%
formatCategoryName(key) converts 'system_design' -> 'System Design'

steps.title: Create ConfidencePercent component
steps.description: Numeric confidence display with color coding

acceptance_criteria.description: ConfidencePercent({ value }) renders '75%' badge
Color: text-error for <40, text-warning for 40-60, text-success for >60
Size variants: 'sm' (text-xs), 'md' (text-sm)
Shows '--' when value is undefined/null

steps.title: Create SessionConfidenceBar component
steps.description: Aggregate session confidence display for panel header

acceptance_criteria.description: SessionConfidenceBar({ understanding }) renders full-width progress bar
Calculates weighted average of all specialist confidences
Bar color: bg-error (<40), bg-warning (40-60), bg-success (>60)
Shows percentage label at right end
Hover tooltip shows breakdown by specialist

aggregation.method: Weighted average where weight = number of categories per specialist

steps.title: Create CategoryTag component
steps.description: Tag showing category name with optional confidence indicator

acceptance_criteria.description: CategoryTag({ name, confidence }) renders pill tag
Shows formatted category name (System Design, not system_design)
Low confidence (<50%) gets warning border/indicator
Base styling matches KeywordTag but with subtle confidence tint
